strings.В московской исповедной ведомости за 185: In the Moscow confession register for 1853 he is named as a 23-year-old peasant of Count Sheremetev from the village of Kostyurina, Yaroslavl governorate. The age is confirmed by two digital copies; the earlier reading of 62 was erroneous.
strings.Прасковья Трофимова, 43 лет, относится к: Praskovya Trofimova, aged 43, belongs with Nikifor Nikolayev in the preceding family. She is not Deomid's documented wife; the earlier conclusion about his death between 1853 and 1858 has been withdrawn.
strings.С Диомидом Амфилохиевичем Стрункиным, ко: Not automatically merged with Diomid Amfilokhiyevich Strunkin, aged 37 in 1858: the difference in ages requires independent research.
strings.Родство с Евграфом Анфилоговым и людьми: Kinship with Yevgraf Anfilogov and with people of the 16th century has not been established.
strings.В двух независимых копиях строка№238 наз: In two independent copies, line No. 238 names 62-year-old Nikifor Nikolayev and his 43-year-old wife Praskovya. The next, separate line No. 239 names Deomid Anfilogov, aged 23. The earlier attribution to Deomid of the age of 62 and of the wife Praskovya has been withdrawn.
strings.В 1853 году московская исповедная ведомо: In 1853 a Moscow confession register names 23-year-old Deomid Anfilogov from Kostyurina and 19-year-old Yevgraf Anfilogov from the Yukhot area. Kinship between them is not stated. 62-year-old Nikifor Nikolayev and 43-year-old Praskovya Trofimovna are a separate married couple from the preceding entry.
Kinship between Deomid and Yevgraf is not stated.
strings.23-летнего Деомида 1853 нельзя автоматич: Deomid, aged 23 in 1853, cannot automatically be identified with Diomid, aged 37 in 1858: a separate check of the ages is required.
